 1          WHEREAS, Plaintiff Apple, Inc. (“Apple”) has filed a Complaint alleging, among other things,
 2   that Defendant Chen Shi (“Shi”) breached his Intellectual Property Agreement with Apple and that
 3   Guangdong Oppo Mobile Telecommunications Corp., Ltd. (“OPPO”) and InnoPeak Technologies, Inc.
 4   (“InnoPeak”) (collectively, OPPO and InnoPeak are referenced as the “Corporate Defendants”) have
 5   violated the Defend Trade Secrets Act;
 6          WHEREAS, Apple thereafter filed an Ex Parte Application for Temporary Restraining Order,
 7   Motion for Order to Show Cause Re Preliminary Injunction, and Expedited Discovery (“TRO
 8   Application”) seeking certain interim relief against Defendants;
 9          WHEREAS, Defendants dispute Apple’s allegations and make no admissions regarding the merits
10   of either Apple’s underlying claims or its request for interim relief; and
11          WHEREAS, the Parties agree that this Stipulation and Proposed Order below is not an admission
12   by either side as to the merits of the parties’ claims or defenses, the scope or entitlement to interim relief
13   by any party, nor a waiver of any claim or defense including that the Court lacks personal jurisdiction over
14   any Defendant.
15          NOW, THEREFORE, the Parties hereby agree and stipulate as follows:
16   1.     Defendant Guangdong Oppo Mobile Telecommunications Corp., Ltd. (“OPPO”) and Defendant
17   InnoPeak Technologies, Inc. (“InnoPeak”) (collectively the “Corporate Defendants”) will each conduct
18   a reasonable search for the files listed in the attached Exhibit A , and any files or materials derived from,
19   concerning or referencing those files, on the devices and systems to which Defendant Chen Shi (“Shi”)
20   had access. If either of the Corporate Defendants locates any copy of any of the files listed in the
21   attached Exhibit A, or any other Apple file transferred or copied by Shi to either of the Corporate
22   Defendants, or any files or materials derived from, related to or referencing those files, it will quarantine
23   those files such that they can be accessed only by members of the Corporate Defendants’ information
24   technology department as needed for purposes related to this matter, and designate them as “Highly
25   Confidential – Attorneys’ Eyes Only” consistent with the Northern District of California Model
26   Protective Order For Litigation Involving Patents, Highly Sensitive Confidential Information and/or
27   Trade Secrets Provision 7.3(a), (c)-(f).
28

     STIPULATION AND [PROPOSED] ORDER                   1                         CASE NO. 5:25-CV-07105-EKL
             Case 5:25-cv-07105-EKL           Document 30        Filed 08/26/25     Page 3 of 6



 1   2.     Defendants (including subsidiaries, officers, agents, and employees) will not disclose or use any
 2   files and materials identified in the search referenced in Paragraph 1 above except as required by law;
 3   3.     Shi and the Corporate Defendants (including subsidiaries, officers, agents, and employees) will
 4   comply with their obligations under the law to preserve all documents, data, devices, communications,
 5   and other evidence potentially relevant to the facts and circumstances of this case;
 6   4.     The Corporate Defendants (including subsidiaries, officers, agents, and employees) will
 7   quarantine Dr. Zijing Zeng (“Zeng”), the Vice President and Head of OPPO Health, and Shi’s company-
 8   issued devices such that the devices will be held and preserved and will prevent Zeng and Shi from
 9   accessing OPPO and InnoPeak’s systems and facilities; and
10   5.     By agreement of the parties, this Order shall remain in place until the Court rules on Apple’s
11   forthcoming preliminary injunction motion.
